$comment: ADR-059 time-boxed audit exemptions. Read by scripts/audit-exemptions.js, which CI and tests/regression/sprint-75-security-gate.test.ts both call. Rules: exact package + GHSA id (no wildcards), high severity only (critical is never exemptible), every field required, expiry at most 30 days after creation (raised from 7 in Sprint 125 — see ADR-059 'Renewal cadence'; the weekly .github/workflows/image-size-advisory-watch.yml now carries the re-measurement obligation the shorter cap used to force). The gate FAILS on a malformed, expired, or unmatched entry — an exemption that no longer matches a live advisory means upstream shipped a fix and it must be deleted.

exemptions.rationale: Re-measured upstream on 2026-08-17 via scripts/check-image-size-upstream.js against live arbiters, unchanged from the 2026-08-11 measurement: image-size latest remains 2.0.2 and the advisory range is <= 2.0.2, so every published version is affected and first_patched_version is null; the advisory is not withdrawn; metro newest remains 0.87.0 and still declares image-size ^1.0.2, so upgrading metro does not help; image-size 2.x drops the default export metro/src/Assets.js requires. Remediation was attempted and rejected on evidence: patch-package cannot clear this finding because the ADR-059 gate audits package-lock.json (npm audit --package-lock-only), which a source patch does not change. Reach is apps/mobile -> expo@57.0.12 -> @expo/metro@56.0.0 -> metro@0.84.4 -> image-size@1.2.1, a dev-time bundler that ships in no deployed image.
exemptions.decision: Sprint 125 maintainer authorization, 2026-08-17; ADR-059 amendment 'Renewal cadence (Sprint 125)'

The same lockfile-vs-source reasoning above rules out patch-package as remediation.
